alerts.headline: Flood Warning issued June 25 at 9:12AM CDT until June 26 at 11:00AM CDT by NWS Houston/Galveston TX
alerts.description:
...The Flood Warning is extended for the following rivers in Texas...

Navasota River near Normangee affecting Madison, Brazos and
Grimes Counties.

For the Navasota River...including Normangee...Minor flooding is
forecast.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Navasota River near Normangee.

* WHEN...Until late tomorrow morning.

* IMPACTS...At 15.0 feet, Minor lowland flooding begins as water
escapes the main channel and inundates the floodplain.
At 17.0 feet, Minor lowland flooding continues with widespread
inundation of the floodplain in the vicinity of the gage with the
river more than 1 mile wide. Long Trussel Road in northeast Brazos
County below State Highway 21 is threatened.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 8:00 AM CDT Thursday the stage was 15.1 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 12.0 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours
ending at 8:00 AM CDT Thursday was 15.8 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to fall below flood stage
this afternoon and continue falling to 6.7 feet Tuesday
morning.
- Flood stage is 15.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of
15.2 feet on 05/22/2015.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

alerts.description:
At 516 PM CDT, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a tornado
was located 5 miles south of Slapout, or 16 miles southwest of
Laverne, moving east at 15 mph.

HAZARD...Tornado and half dollar size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without
shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed. Damage
to roofs, windows, and vehicles will occur.  Tree damage is
likely.

This tornadic thunderstorm will remain over mainly rural areas of
southeastern Beaver and northeastern Lipscomb Counties.

Grimes Counties.

forecast.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Navasota River near Normangee.

* WHEN...Until late tomorrow morning.

* IMPACTS...At 15.0 feet, Minor lowland flooding begins as water
escapes the main channel and inundates the floodplain.
At 17.0 feet, Minor lowland flooding continues with widespread
inundation of the floodplain in the vicinity of the gage with the
river more than 1 mile wide. Long Trussel Road in northeast Brazos
County below State Highway 21 is threatened.

- At 8:00 AM CDT Thursday the stage was 15.1 feet.

ending at 8:00 AM CDT Thursday was 15.8 feet.

this afternoon and continue falling to 6.7 feet Tuesday
morning.

15.2 feet on 05/22/2015.
